verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
And I know I'm weak
I know I'm unworthy
To call upon Your name
But because of grace,
Because of Your mercy
I stand here unashamed

verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
I have not much to offer You
Not near what You deserve
But still I come because Your cross
Has placed in me my worth

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Oh, Christ my King of sympathy
Whose wounds secure my peace
Your grace extends to call me friend
Your mercy sets me free

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
I can't explain this kind of love
I'm humbled and amazed
That You'd come down from heaven's heights
And greet me face to face

verse.name: e1
verse.lines:
Here I am at Your feet
In my brokenness complete
Here I am at Your feet
In my brokenness complete

verse.name: c2
verse.lines:
And I know I'm weak, I know I'm unworthy
To call upon Your name
But because of grace, just cause You love me
I stand here unashamed

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Oh, Christ my King of sympathy
Whose wounds secure my peace
Your grace extends from heaven's heights
Your mercy sets me free
